TICKET_PANEL_DESCRIPTION:
Select a category below to open a support ticket.
Choose the category that best fits your request.
TICKET_WELCOME:
Hey {user}! The staff team will be with you shortly.

Please describe your issue in as much detail as possible.

*Ticket ID: #{ticketId}*
TICKET_NOT_FOUND: This channel is not a ticket.
TICKET_BANNED: You are not allowed to create tickets.
TICKET_NOT_BANNED: This user does not have a ticket ban.
TICKET_ADD_SUCCESS: {user} has been added to the ticket.
TICKET_REMOVE_SUCCESS: {user} has been removed from the ticket.
TICKET_CLOSE_REQUEST_BODY: A staff member wants to close this ticket. Confirm below if you agree.
TICKET_CLOSE_REQUEST_CANCELLED_BODY: The close request has been cancelled.
TICKET_TRANSCRIPT_DM_BODY: Your ticket in **{guildName}** has been closed. A transcript is attached below.
UNBAN_INVALID_USER: This user ID could not be found.
UNMUTE_DM_BODY: Your mute in **{guildName}** has been lifted.
INVALID_MUTE_DURATION: Invalid duration. Use formats like `10m`, `1h`, or `7d` (max 28 days).
NO_PERMISSION_BAN: You do not have permission to ban members.
NO_PERMISSION_KICK: You do not have permission to kick members.
NO_PERMISSION_MUTE: You do not have permission to mute members.
NO_PERMISSION_MANAGE: You do not have permission to use this command.
NO_PERMISSION_STAFF: This command is for staff only.
NO_PERMISSION_HIGHER_ROLE: You cannot perform an action on someone with an equal or higher role.
BOT_NO_PERMISSION: I do not have permission to do that.
APPLICATION_PANEL_DESCRIPTION:
**Open Positions:**
- Helper
- Builder
- Media
- Beta-Tester

Have questions? Open a support ticket.
APPLICATION_PANEL_FOOTER: Select a role to start your application.
APPLICATION_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an active application. Finish or cancel it before starting a new one.
APPLICATION_DM_BLOCKED: I was unable to send you a DM. Make sure your DMs are open and try again.
APPLICATION_STARTED_BODY: Check your DMs to continue your application.
APPLICATION_CONFIRM_BODY:
You are about to apply for **{category}**.

I will ask you a series of questions — you have **{hours} hours** to answer them. You can cancel at any time.
APPLICATION_CONFIRM_BUILDER_NOTE: > **Note:** The Builder role is entirely voluntary. Builders have no additional permissions and the work is unpaid.
APPLICATION_CONFIRM_DEV_NOTE: > **Note:** The Developer role is entirely voluntary. All submissions require full source code and the work is unpaid.
APPLICATION_IN_PROGRESS_BODY: You have **{hours} hours** to complete this application. Press Cancel at any time to stop.
APPLICATION_SUMMARY_BODY: Review your answers below. You can still edit anything before submitting.
APPLICATION_SUMMARY_FOOTER: Take your time — you can edit any answer before submitting.
APPLICATION_UPDATED_FALLBACK: Could not update the summary. Here is your updated application:
APPLICATION_SUBMITTED_BODY: We have received your application. The staff team will review it and get back to you.
APPLICATION_TIMEOUT_BODY: Your application expired after {hours} hours. You can start a new one at any time.
APPLICATION_ACCEPTED_REASON_BODY:
Your **{category}** application has been accepted!

**Message from staff:** {reason}
APPLICATION_DENIED_BODY:
Your **{category}** application was not accepted this time.

You are welcome to apply again in **30 days** after working on your skills.
APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND: This application could not be found.
APPLICATION_SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please start a new application.
APPLICATION_INVALID_QUESTION: That is not a valid question number. Enter a number between 1 and {max}.
APPLICATION_NO_MANAGEMENT: You do not have permission to review applications.
REPORT_BANNED: You are not allowed to submit reports.
REPORT_NO_STAFF: You need a staff role to handle reports.
GENERIC_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
GENERIC_DB_ERROR: A database error occurred. Please try again.
